records.name: Parque de Maria Luisa
records.location: Parque de María Luisa, Sevilla, around southern wooded paths near Avenida de la Palmera; exact sites or coordinates uncertain
records.description: Historic public garden and tourist park with multiple independent cruising-directory references. This research queue aligns Gays-Cruising and source 7 Squirt.org, although its archived Squirt record has no URL. Additional independent cruisingmap has forum messages dated August 2026 proposing encounters, and GayOut's current October 2026 description identifies the southern park paths. These are credible signs of ongoing online attention, not proof of completed on-site sexual encounters. Municipal winter park hours are 08:00–22:00; an old directory comment recommending access through a damaged fence should not be followed.
